product_metadata.title: The Original McKenzie® D-Section Lumbar Roll by OPTP (700)
features: Made in the USA: Constructed of high-quality foam with a removable, moisture-wicking polyester mock mesh cover.

Professional Designed: Designed by world-renowned physical therapist, Robin McKenzie, The Original McKenzie D-Section Lumbar Roll is recommended and trusted by Physical therapist, chiropractor, and back pain professionals around the world.
Extra Support: This lumbar support is best-suited for larger individuals, or those that require a greater amount of back support. D-shaped designed rests flat against chair backs.
Unique Shape: D-shaped design rests flat against chair backs, preventing the support from moving around. Improves posture and helps correct mechanical back pain.

Measures approximately 11”L x 4.25”D x 5.5”H. Features a new and improved built-in adjustable strap made from a thick, high quality material and can be adjusted to fit most chair backs; contains latex.
